title.narrative: Trauma Programme and integrated livelihood activities (as part of exit period)

description.narrative: This project will integrate 1920 orphans headed households and young girls victims of violence located in Gasabo, Kamonyi, Nyanza and Rwamagana. After their identification, the first step will be a TOT for staff who will organize the Community Development Workers (CDW) trainings. The CDW trained will be able to give emotional and economical ‘first aid’. We will also work with NKUNDABANA and APS to identify within the communities those orphans suffering from trauma and refer them to a counsellor. This underlines that the individual therapeutic sessions led by psychologist and counsellor will take place within our center. Through sensitisation and exchanges, various projects will be set up in terms of reinforcing income generating projects (including farming projects and handicrafts).There will be financial support of innovative and successful individual or group projects; the Organization has set up an appropriate method of distributing the money and working closely with local authorities. Adequate mechanisms of fund distribution and follow up will be communicated to all parties, refresher course for community volunteers will be conducted and Meeting of different professionals involved in trauma healing process and livelihood will take place for exchanging experiences on on-going cases.
